ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circular schematic diagram of the cell cycle, divided into stages such as G1, S, G2 and M (mitosis, mitosis), and labeled with the duration of each stage, for example G1 about 10 hours, S about 9 hours, G2 about 4 hours. Reasoning: The question asks in which stage chromosomes replicate. Chromosome replication corresponds to DNA synthesis, and DNA synthesis occurs in the S phase of the cell cycle. Therefore the answer is S.
